scope: P1-A68 complete classic Man Chong, Junxing and Yuce runtime, AI, WPF presentation and official portrait
selectedVersion: 一将成名官网当前经典满宠（魏3体力，峻刑／御策）

sources.use: 一将成名官方武将页冻结当前经典满宠、峻刑与御策文本，并提供经典静态大图入口。
官方历史规则文章用于交叉核对峻刑的多牌类别约束，以及御策展示后由伤害来源弃置异类别牌的结算。
官方历史攻略用于交叉核对经典满宠的魏势力、3 体力与技能组合。

ruleText.junxing: 出牌阶段限一次，你可以弃置至少一张手牌并选择一名其他角色，令其选择一项：1.弃置与你弃置的牌类别均不同的一张手牌；2.翻面，然后摸等量的牌。
ruleText.yuce: 每当你受到伤害后，你可以展示一张手牌，令来源选择是否弃置与之类别不同的一张手牌，若其选择否，你回复1点体力。

implementation.junxingInteraction: once per Play phase, select one or more exact hand cards and one other living target; all discarded cost categories are frozen, then the target privately chooses one exact hand card whose category differs from every cost category or always-available turn-over-and-draw-equal branch
implementation.yuceInteraction: after damage, the owner privately reveals one exact hand card or skips; the source privately discards one exact hand card of a different category or declines, while no eligible source card immediately resolves as decline and recovers the owner by one
implementation.aiPolicy: Junxing chooses the cheapest legal target response unless turning over is favorable; Yuce reveals deterministically and the source pays the cheapest eligible different-category card when available

versionBoundary.replayPolicy: accepted commands reconstruct Junxing costs and category challenge, Yuce reveal and source response, private prompts, exact movements, face state, recovery and public events under rules v101
versionBoundary.legacyPolicy: package 1.95.0 retains the complete Guo Huai roster without Man Chong; package signature and content hash provide the new-content boundary

portrait.attribution: Official classic Man Chong artwork reused only for the user's local experiment under explicit authorization

acceptance.visualReview: 224 through 226 at 1120x740 inspected: official card art, exact Junxing target draft, Yuce reveal-card prompt and skip branch are readable without clipping or overlap
assertions: package 1.96.0 publishes complete Man Chong while package 1.95.0 retains its prior Guo Huai boundary
Junxing freezes every selected cost category and only permits a target discard whose category differs from them all
Junxing always retains the alternative branch that turns the target over and draws exactly the discarded-card count
Yuce reveals without moving the owner's card and only permits the source to discard a different-category hand card
decline, no eligible counter-card or absent living source recovers the owner by exactly one while a legal discard prevents recovery
paused Junxing and Yuce choices replay with identical state, events and legal actions
WPF exposes Active and Trigger metadata, exact private choices, public reveal, player guidance, event stack and battle cues

deferred: real Windows desktop mouse and keyboard acceptance
physical multiplayer host and remote-client acceptance
